scope: Retained workstream records are byte-identical except for 22 explicitly annotated whitespace-only normalizations and 7 documented reversible patch wrappers or Git-object JSON annotations. Original and retained SHA-256 values are recorded for every changed representation. The transformation entry describes how to recover exact patch bytes or original JSON data; source JSON formatting remains identified by its original byte hash. Generated final reports and transformed API summaries are documented separately.

files.normalization: Trailing ASCII spaces/tabs on LF-delimited lines and the final LF count only; all other bytes and line order unchanged.

transformation.decode: Recursively replace sole-key git_object_sha1 and sha256_digest objects with their string values to reconstruct the original JSON data. All 26 SHA-1 values in these three reviewed inputs were verified to resolve to Git objects. SHA-256 values retain their source-declared checksum meaning. Original byte hashes are retained separately; no scanner exception is introduced.
